briefdescription.para: Arithmetic engine for tower-polynomial rings: (Z/p)[x_0][x_1]...[x_{nvars-1}] modulo a chain of extensions.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the characteristic p, the number of variables, and an extensions array one tower-polynomial per algebraic level giving the relation that defines the next variable over the previous (nullptr means transcendental, captured by degree_of_extension < 0). Almost every public operation (mult, add_in_place, gcd, resultant, pseudo_division, ...) takes an explicit level argument that dispatches the recursive descent down the tower. Used by DRing, which fixes a particular working level on top of a shared DPoly.
